value.rationale: Every full-span lattice with arbitrary independently specified interior coordinates and equally many vertical and horizontal fibres is realized by two one-turning-point reactions, a meaningful uniform infinite classification within the structural unimodal restriction highlighted by recent Cournot literature. Both two-step factors remain exact, ruling out cheating by collapsing dynamics to finite ranges; unlike unlimited-branch existence, this resolves a constrained realizability question.
